title: Independent Verification, Safe HITL and Rollback
summary: Why the gate asks, and how to answer well

lessons.title: Risk classes
lessons.body: Nerve v2 classifies tool calls: safe-routine and project work flow automatically; uncertain gets the model; consequential prompts with explanation; prohibited blocks.

lessons.title: Effect-bound approvals
lessons.body: Approvals bind to the exact effect: same commits for a push, exact content for a write, every file in multi-file reads. Repeats of unidentifiable effects re-approve.

lessons.title: Honest prompts
lessons.body: Prompts explain action/why/impact/risks and offer safer alternatives. Confidence numbers are never the reason.

lab.goal: Trigger one consequential prompt in a sandbox and classify its four answers.
steps: In a sandbox, attempt a git push (no remote needed - the prompt appears before execution).
lab.expect: You can explain why an [a]lways on a push does not authorize a different commit set.

task.intro: Answer the scenario questions; the engine verifies them deterministically in a disposable fixture. Your answers are never executed as commands.

questions.q: Which class requires explicit human approval? (routine/consequential)
questions.why: Consequential operations need explained, effect-scoped approval.

questions.q: Does the same approval key cover a changed push ref? (yes/no)
questions.why: Approvals bind to the exact effect; changed effects need new approval.
Confidence numbers are never the explanation; explain action/effect/risk.

executable.task: Produce an approval-policy plan binding approvals to effects.

check.question: Q: What does an approval key bind to?
expected_keywords: the exact authorized effect (tool, arguments, workdir, content/commits)

troubleshooting: Recognized routine work never interrupts you - that is the design goal.
Rollback: backups live next to each installation; restore the previous plugin copy.
